column6: MCP background tasks (`SEP-1686`) support  In the latest MCP release (version 2025-11-25), there was a new addition for supporting background tasks. The changelog mentions:  > Add experimental support for tasks to enable tracking durable requests with polling and deferred result retrieval (SEP-1686).  SEP-1686 is a Standards Enhancement Proposal authored by Surbhi Bansal and Luca Chang from Amazon that introduces a "Tasks" primitive to better support long-running, workflow-based operations. The proposal addresses limitations in the current MCP specification where there's no way for clients to explicitly query the status of a tool call or retrieve results after completion. This is particularly problematic for operations taking minutes to hours, such as drug interaction analysis, code migration, or comprehensive test suite execution.  The proposed solution introduces a task primitive with an associated task ID that enables "call-now, fetch-later" execution patterns, allowing clients to query task state and results up to a server-defined duration after completion.  I tried to test this feature and I get Tool 'toon-name' requires task-augmented execution when adk hits the tool. Does ADK needs to build support for this new feature or is there some configuration on my side that can allow this?
